Anna M: Quick proposal: run 'micro-trials' (2.5 week) focused pilots instead of long betas. Goal = rapid, testable signals for roadmap prioritization.
Priya S: +1. shorter run = lower commitment. what's the selection criteria?
Anna M: propose: 1) clear integration hypothesis, 2) <2 engineer-days to onboard, 3) product manager available for weekly check-ins, 4) consent to share sanitized prompt-output pairs.
Mark D: add requirement: must be able to route traffic to a tagged pool (microtrial) or agree to synthetic traffic if not. avoids noisy neighbor issues.
Lucas C: timeline suggestion: week -1 recruit + legal check, week0 onboarding (sherpa session + short install guide), weeks1-2 active, week2.5 wrap + exit interview.
Elaine T: incentives: $5k credits for Dedicated or 6 weeks priority support + onboarding hours. one off open slot for self-serve small startup.
Priya S: can we have templates? I'll draft invite + consent + PM checklist. sample invite snippet: ```Hi {name}, we'd love to invite you to a 3-week micro-trial to validate X. You'd get a sherpa-led kickoff, Dedicated credits, and a short exit interview. Interested? Reply with best kickoff dates.```
Mark D: telemetry must include: route_tag, model_variant, token_cost_estimate, cache_hit_rate, p50/p95 latency, error_rate_by_prompt. Also flag requests with integration label.
Anna M: launch/pass criteria suggestion: - onboarding completion <= 72h for 70% of participants - core flow p50 <= 350ms - no P1 regressions during cohort - at least 10 labeled prompt pairs per cohort for evals - >= 3 customer-suggested product improvements logged.
Lucas C: also include soft vs hard gates: soft after cohort1 (inform product decisions), hard after cohort3 (stop/scale decision).
Elaine T: recruitment channels: DP alumni list, AMs for enterprise, solutions engineers for mid-market, and one public micro-invite in newsletter. prefer mix of integrators and end-user apps.
Priya S: feedback cadence: day7 async survey (3 q), mid cohort short check, exit 30-min interview + shared eval deck. capture NPS-like question: "Would you build on this?" on 0-10 scale.
Mark D: scope guardrails: each trial has a 'core flow' (5 canonical prompts) and up to 1 stretch feature. no major infra or API changes mid-trial unless security/regression.
Anna M: RACI draft: Product = owner, DevEx = sherpa, EngRuntime = routing/flag, Solutions = recruitment touchpoints, Legal = consent review. resource ask per cohort: DevEx 0.2 FTE, Solutions 0.4 FTE kickoff, EngRuntime 0.1 FTE.
OnboardBot: New doc created: "microtrial-runbook" -> https://redwood.infer/docs/microtrial-runbook (draft).
DeployBot: Reminder: add route tag to deploy checklist for microtrial pool.
Priya S: next steps: I'll post invite + consent templates by Tue EOD; Mark will post telemetry checklist; Lucas will update timeline in launch doc; Anna to write soft/hard gate wording. sync Fri 9:30am. :rocket:
